title: imap AuthConfig::mechanisms is Vec<String> for a two-value enum
description: imap::config::AuthConfig::mechanisms is Vec<String> with only two valid values ("PLAIN", "LOGIN"). The default-value function constructs them as string literals. A caller can insert "GSSAPI" or any string and the server will silently advertise an unsupported mechanism until a client tries it. Idiomatic Rust: define an AuthMechanism enum with Plain and Login variants. serde can deserialize from string with #[serde(rename_all = "SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE")]. This makes invalid values a deserialization error at startup rather than a runtime auth failure.
